entries.note: One view owns everything a format-aware tab needs beyond the text editor: mode and whether the user chose it, the raw window, the sanitized preview, a read-only text buffer, and the selected entry with its own hex/text/error. The UI function only mutates view state and returns an action; app.c owns every request so mode changes, refreshes and entry loads share the generation/staleness rules of ordinary tab loads.

Mirrors the service matcher (case-insensitive *, ? and [...] with ! negation on the base name) so the client's default-mode decision agrees with the server's format choice; keep both in step when extending the glob subset.

entries.note: Directory rows are plain left-aligned buttons keyed by their joined path; expansion lives in the view's own hashed-path set (bounded, oldest dropped past 4,096) and never in microui's 48-slot treenode pool, whose mu_pool_init aborts once every slot was touched in one frame (review finding 1: NOLF.REZ's TEX alone has 22 subdirectories). Indentation is a spacer column, so no ids accumulate on the id stack; RE_METRIC_FORMAT_TREE_DEPTH only bounds recursion and label paths. Files become buttons only when the format declares an entry command; otherwise they are labels so a click cannot promise bytes the project cannot produce.
